merge_basis: T0061 is the ONIS study (CKD GDMT, CK-NET data, cross-sectional, VicaEmpa launch support), while G0048 is an ECR study on HTN+T2D+eCVD patients without HF (Beijing healthcare insurance data, retrospective observational, CVRR/HF prevention strategy). Although both come from the same source file and share the same milestone dates (Dec 2025 CEC&PEC endorsement), they are distinct studies with different research questions, target populations, data sources, designs, and budgets. They must not be merged.
